title: Asynchronous idempotent Agent wakeups
description: Accept heartbeat wakeups without waiting for the full Agent turn, preventing retries from creating duplicate internal messages.
changes: Deliver terminal experiment notifications with client.session.promptAsync.
Deliver semantic checkpoint wakeups with client.session.promptAsync.
Finalize the atomic sent marker as soon as OpenCode accepts the wakeup.
Keep ordinary progress file-backed for the Process panel instead of adding chat turns.

rollback.notes: Restore 20260809-001-singleton-backoff if the installed OpenCode SDK does not support promptAsync.
